One MCP server on the MCP page (click to open its tools), plus the "Register" card.

## Responsibilities
- `McpServerCard` shows `Metric`s and `FooterButton`s: `mcpApi.disconnect` ("Disconnected …"), `reconnect` ("Reconnected …") and `removeServer` ("Removed …").
- `RegisterMcpCard`.
